## My request for Codex:
fix it:

spawn_manager.lua:329, 888, 1095 – CreateManagedTimer is called with only a single function argument, but the helper expects (delay, callback) and wraps callback(); since callback is nil, these timers will throw “attempt to call nil value” as soon as they fire, breaking wave-state updates, permanent spawns, and wave spawning loops.
shop1_manager.lua (lines 975-994) – RemoveAndStoreItems saves stats:GetAbility():GetAbilityName() (already suffixed with level) and ReAddItem passes that to AddItem, which appends another _"..lvl. After hero evolution (selection_special.lua (lines 523-542)), Shop1 items end up with names like item_x_2_2 and fail to re-add, losing the player’s items.

function spawn_manager:StartPermanentSpawner()
    local PermanentKV = PermanentKVRaw["1"]

    if not PermanentKV then return end

    self.permanent_start_time = GameRules:GetGameTime()
    local interval            = tonumber(PermanentKV["Interval"]) or 5

    local monstersKV          = PermanentKV["Monsters"] or {}
    local spawnPointsKV       = PermanentKV["SpawnPoints"] or {}

    local orderedTemplates    =
        BuildOrderedTemplatesUnified(monstersKV, PermanentKV)
    local perTemplatePoints   = BuildPerTemplateSpawnPointsOrdered(spawnPointsKV, orderedTemplates)

    local growthStats         = PermanentKV["GrowthStats"] or {}
    local baseCount           = tonumber(PermanentKV["BaseCount"] or "1") or 1
    local growthCount         = tonumber(PermanentKV["GrowthCount"] or "0") or 0

    self:CreateManagedTimer(function()
        local t = GameRules:GetGameTime() - self.permanent_start_time

        local minutes = math.floor(t / 60)

        local copies
        if growthCount > 10000 and minutes > 0 then
            copies = math.floor(baseCount * (BpToRatio(growthCount) ^ minutes))
        else
            copies = baseCount
        end

        if copies <= 0 then copies = 1 end

        local buff = {}

        for k, multStr in pairs(growthStats) do
            local mult = tonumber(multStr) or 1

            if mult > 1 and minutes > 0 then
                local currentMultiplier = mult ^ minutes

                local buffValue = currentMultiplier - 1

                buff[k] = buffValue
            else
                buff[k] = 0
            end
        end

        local tag = "permanent_" .. tostring(minutes)

        for _, template in ipairs(orderedTemplates) do
            local countStr = monstersKV[template]
            local count    = tonumber(countStr) or 0
            local pts      = perTemplatePoints[template]

            if count > 0 and pts and #pts > 0 then
                self:SpawnGroup({ [template] = tostring(count) }, pts, {
                    copies_per_point = copies,

function spawn_manager:GetRunAliveCount(rid)
    local run = self.runs[rid]
    if not run then return 0 end

    local alive = 0
    for _, u in ipairs(run.monsters) do
        if u and IsValidEntity(u) and u:IsAlive() then
            alive = alive + 1
        end
    end
    return alive

function spawn_manager:CreateManagedTimer(delay, callback)
    local id
    id = Timers:CreateTimer(delay, function()
        return callback()
    end)
    table.insert(self.timer_handles, id)
    return id
end

function spawn_manager:CalcNextWaveAndBoss(fromIndex, startTime)
    local acc_time  = startTime or GameRules:GetGameTime()
    local next_wave = 0
    local next_boss = 0

    -- 从 fromIndex 之后的那一波开始（0 表示从第 1 波开始看）
    for i = fromIndex, 999 do
        local w = WavesKV[tostring(i)]
        if not w then break end

        local pre = tonumber(w["PreDelay"]) or 0
        local dur = tonumber(w["Duration"]) or 0
        local isB = (tostring(w["IsBossWave"] or "0") == "1")

        acc_time = acc_time + pre

        if (not isB) and next_wave == 0 then
            next_wave = acc_time
        end

        if isB and next_boss == 0 then
            next_boss = acc_time
        end

        -- 如果找到了普通波生成点，且已经确定了下一个 Boss 点（或之后没 Boss），则退出
        if next_wave > 0 and (next_boss > 0 or i > fromIndex + 5) then
            break
        end

        -- 累加持续时间，用于计算再下一波的起点
        acc_time = acc_time + dur
    end

    return next_wave, next_boss
end

    local empty_slots = {}

                table.insert(empty_slots, key)
            end

        if #empty_slots < 1 then

        local random = RandomInt(1, #empty_slots)
